text:
Situation: Argatroban 50 mg/50 mL vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 74 vials (8.2 days); Corvale General holds 159 vials (16.5 days). Both sites use product labeled by Eugia US LLC (NDC 55150024101) manufactured at Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited in India (FEI 3008461619).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected that plant on 2026-02-06 and classified the inspection OAI; the classification was posted on 2026-09-21. An earlier OAI inspection ended 2024-02-02 with a warning letter issued 2024-08-15.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below target. Corvale General can spare inventory without dropping below two weeks. No shortage is declared by FDA. Alternative manufacturers are not on the shortage list but their labels do not identify a plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 23 vials of argatroban 50 mg/50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchasing from Accord Healthcare Inc. if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchasing from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchasing from Caplin Steriles Limited if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchasing from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
